title: Witness and Parish
author: Cyrus Yarrow
blurb: Oscar Ashgrove, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
